% =========================
% RESEARCH INTERESTS
% =========================

\section*{Research Interests}
%\vspace{-\baselineskip} % Adjust spacing if needed
My research investigates the interplay between policy, financial systems, and the macroeconomy. I am particularly interested in the interaction of fiscal and monetary policies and their impact on economic outcomes. My work is organized around three key areas:

\begin{description}[font=\normalfont\textbf, leftmargin=2.5cm, style=nextline, itemsep=0.5\baselineskip]
    \item[Macroeconomic Policy \& Stabilization:] Analyzing the transmission mechanisms and effectiveness of monetary policy, alongside fiscal policy, in managing economic growth, inflation, and investment. Also exploring how economic uncertainty and FinTech developments challenge traditional policy frameworks.
    
    \item[Public Finance, Growth, \& Financial Stability:] Studying the role of public finance---including taxation, government expenditure, and sovereign debt---in long-term growth and financial market stability. 
    
    \item[International Trade \& Capital Flows:] Assessing how trade policies, tariffs, and fiscal incentives shape global trade patterns and capital flows. Examining the fiscal and macroeconomic consequences of trade barriers, protectionism, and shifts in global value chains.
\end{description}

\vspace{10pt}

% =========================
% TEACHING INTERESTS
% =========================

\section*{Teaching Interests}
My teaching interests complement my research and span the theoretical, empirical, and policy-oriented foundations of economics.

\begin{itemize}
    \item Microeconomic Theory (Principles, Intermediate)
    \item Macroeconomic Theory (Principles, Intermediate)
    \item Econometrics \& Applied Empirical Methods
    \item Mathematical Economics \& Optimization
    \item Public Finance / Public Economics
    \item Monetary Economics
 %   \item International Trade
\end{itemize}
\vspace{10pt}

    ),
    "\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}

```{r, results="asis"}
# Presentations / Conferences
cat("\n\n\\section*{Presentations / Conferences}\n\n")

talks_df <- cv$presentations |>
  mutate(
    date_parsed = suppressWarnings(as.Date(date)),
    year = ifelse(
      is.na(date_parsed),
      "",
      format(date_parsed, "%Y")
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(date_parsed))

# Print each category
for (grp in unique(talks_df$category)) {

  df <- talks_df |>
    filter(category == grp)

  if (nrow(df) == 0) next

  cat(
    paste0("\\subsection*{", latex_escape(grp), "}\n\n")
  )

  # Print each presentation
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {

    entry <- paste0(
      "\\hangindent=2.2em \\hangafter=1 ",
      i, ". ",
      "\\textbf{", latex_escape(df$title[i]), "}",

      if (!is.na(df$organised[i]) && nzchar(df$organised[i]))
        paste0(", organised by ", latex_escape(df$organised[i]))
      else
        "",

      if (!is.na(df$location[i]) && nzchar(df$location[i]))
        paste0(", ", latex_escape(df$location[i]))
      else
        "",

      if (nzchar(df$year[i]))
        paste0(", ", df$year[i], ".")
      else
        "."
    )

    cat(entry, "\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r, results="asis"}
# TEACHING
cat("\n\n\\section*{Teaching}\n\n")

# Courses are grouped by level and run into a sentence rather than set as
# a table: the old Level column repeated three values down twelve rows and
# cost most of a page. Keep these labels in step with TEACH_LEVELS in the
# website's R/helpers.R so both documents read the same.
level_names <- c(UG = "Undergraduate", PG = "Postgraduate", PhD = "Ph.D.")

for (inst in unique(cv$teaching$institution)) {

  df_inst <- cv$teaching |> filter(institution == inst)
  if (nrow(df_inst) == 0) next

  cat("\\subsection*{", latex_escape(inst), "}\n\n", sep = "")

  # Any level code not in level_names still prints, under its raw code
  lvls <- c(names(level_names),
            setdiff(unique(df_inst$level[!is.na(df_inst$level)]), names(level_names)))

  for (lvl in lvls) {

    courses <- df_inst |>
      filter(!is.na(level) & level == lvl) |>
      arrange(course_title) |>
      pull(course_title)

    courses <- courses[!is.na(courses) & courses != ""]
    if (!length(courses)) next

    heading <- if (lvl %in% names(level_names)) level_names[[lvl]] else lvl

    cat(
      "\\hangindent=1.5em \\hangafter=1 ",
      "\\textbf{", latex_escape(heading), ":} ",
      paste(latex_escape(courses), collapse = "; "),
      ".\n\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  }
}
```

```{r, results="asis"}
# ADVISING
cat("\n\n\\section*{Advising}\n\n")

adv_heading <- function(level) {
  switch(
    level,
    phd = "Ph.D. Students",
    ms = "Masters Students",
    ug = "Undergraduate Students",
    hs = "High School Students",
    committee = "Ph.D. Committee Member",
    latex_escape(level)
  )
}

for (lvl in c("phd", "ms", "ug", "hs", "committee")) {
  df <- cv$advising |> filter(level == lvl)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) next
  
  cat("\\subsection*{", adv_heading(lvl), "}\n\n", sep = "")
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
    cat("\\hangindent=1.5em \\hangafter=1 ",
      i, ". ",
      latex_escape(df$name[i]),
      ifelse(!is.na(df$title[i]) & df$title[i] != "",
             paste0(", ``", latex_escape(df$title[i]), "''"), ""),
      ", ", latex_escape(df$institution[i]),
      " (", df$start_year[i], "--", df$end_year[i], ").",
      ifelse(!is.na(df$notes[i]) & df$notes[i] != "",
             paste0(" ", latex_escape(df$notes[i])), ""),
      "\n\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  }
}
```
